purpose: Teach: 連勝/指紋/まっとう/集う/体裁/課し/フランチャイズ/振込み

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、連勝の勢いで、絶対、犯罪、絶対、解決、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We at the police department are working hard to solve crimes with full commitment, and we're truly grateful for your support.
lines.style: Measured, official cadence. Steady eye contact. The weight of public responsibility in the pause before 'truly grateful.' Professional but human.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。現場、本気で、絶対、指紋、絶対、採取、絶対、進めて、警察、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with collecting fingerprints from the scene, and we're truly grateful for the police department's thorough work.
lines.style: Attentive, aligned. Slight nod on 'yes.' Respectful pace. The tone of someone deferring to expertise while showing genuine partnership.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: まっとうな、本気で、絶対、市民、絶対、警察、絶対、応援してくださっております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: It's good citizens like you who support the police. We're grateful for that trust.
lines.style: Slightly softer than before. Recognition settling in the voice. Warm but still formal — acknowledging the human side of the work without stepping out of uniform.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域、本気で、絶対、住民、絶対、集う場、絶対、警察、絶対、見守ってくださってますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. You're doing exactly what communities need — gathering people together, watching out for each other. The police are watching over you too.
lines.style: Earnest, almost tender beneath the formal words. Slower pace. A man speaking directly, not reading protocol. Small pause before 'watching over you.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、市民の体裁、絶対、保てるよう、絶対、慎重に、本気で、対応、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're proceeding carefully to make sure the community's reputation and safety are protected. We take that responsibility seriously.
lines.style: Deliberate, each phrase carrying weight. Slight emphasis on 'carefully' and 'responsibility.' The voice of someone who has seen the cost of carelessness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、要請、絶対、課した業務、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're fulfilling all the duties the police have requested of us, and we're grateful for the partnership.
lines.style: Steady, businesslike but genuine. Mid-range tone — neither deferential nor over-confident. The voice of a person doing their part and knowing it matters.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、フランチャイズ防犯、絶対、店舗、絶対、見守ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll continue watching over your franchise locations. That's our commitment to keeping your community safe.
lines.style: Reassuring, concrete. The 'we'll continue' sits firm in the voice — a promise more than a statement. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察に、本気で、絶対、寄付、絶対、振込み、絶対、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making a donation to the police department to support their work. Thank you for everything you're doing.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. No fanfare on the donation — stated as natural follow-through. Slight warmth at the end. The tone of someone doing what feels right.
